WITH per_group AS (
  SELECT s.zoneref, st.typesite,
         AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio,
         AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_size_per_minute
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN sites AS st ON st.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
  WHERE s.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274'
    AND s.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
  GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.typesite
)
SELECT AVG(avg_pressratio) AS avg_group_compression_ratio,
       AVG(avg_size_per_minute) AS avg_group_size_per_minute
FROM per_group;
